question: For a certain number of observations the median is 55 and the mean is 58. Find the mode.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use the **Empirical Formula**: **Mode** = 3 × **Median** − 2 × **Mean**

Given **Median** = 55 and **Mean** = 58

**Mode** = 3 × 55 − 2 × 58 = 165 − 116 = 49

**∴ The correct answer is 49.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Median** of the observations = 55

**Arithmetic Mean** of the observations = 58

**Formula Used:**

The relationship between **Mean**, **Median**, and **Mode** for a moderately skewed distribution is:

**Mode** = 3(**Median**) − 2(**Mean**)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b3fd90c242d1aa2fb1f7949faf026d7b029ab02f508990aaef352ec8491098dd.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ **Mode** = (3 × 55) − (2 × 58)

⇒ **Mode** = 165 − 116

⇒ **Mode** = 49

**∴ The correct answer is 49.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Empirical Relationship

For a frequency distribution, the **Mode** is approximately equal to the difference between three times the **Median** and twice the **Mean**.

Symmetrical Distribution

If the distribution is **perfectly symmetrical**, then **Mean** = **Median** = **Mode**.

Skewness Property

In a **negatively skewed** distribution, **Mean** < **Median** < **Mode**. In this specific question, **Mode** (49) < **Median** (55) < **Mean** (58), indicating the distribution is **positively skewed**.</p
